summary.en: Cardiometabolic medicines dominate this selection, with late-stage obesity, amylin and Lp(a) programs alongside oncology and Alzheimer’s candidates. Both internal discovery and external licensing contribute.

watch.en: Q3 sales of Mounjaro and Zepbound were $10.7bn and $5.4bn, respectively, against $24.4bn total revenue.

watch.en: The Q3 outlook still lists a diabetes decision for orforglipron and TRANSCEND-T2D-3 disclosure in 2026.

watch.en: Q3 acquired IPR&D charges reached $4.2bn; AtaiBeckley closed in Q3 and Merida closed after quarter-end.
watch.zh: Q3 收购在研项目费用约42亿美元；AtaiBeckley 收购于当季完成，Merida 收购于季后完成。

watch.en: Year-to-date capital investments were $8.4bn, alongside $19.0bn allocated to business development.
watch.zh: 年初至今资本投资约84亿美元，业务拓展投入约190亿美元。
